The game features real-time leaderboards and cloud-saved high scores using Supabase, along with dynamic synthwave sound effects from the Freesound API.

challenges_faced:
🧩 Supabase Integration
Managing real-time leaderboard updates and syncing player scores without conflict was tricky.

🔊 Freesound API Usage
Integrating and loading external sound effects dynamically required handling API limits and response delays.

🎮 Game Balancing
Tuning enemy difficulty, fire rate, and power-ups to keep gameplay fair but exciting.

⚙️ Performance Optimization
Reducing lag caused by frequent animations and sprite effects, especially during intense battles.

🖼 Retro Theme UI
Maintaining a cool synthwave aesthetic while keeping text and visuals readable.

🔐 Score Integrity
Preventing users from editing scores through browser dev tools or fake requests.

💻 Platform Limitation
Designing for PC-only meant missing out on mobile users, but it allowed for a richer experience.

feature_list:
Here are the main features of the Goalie website:

Onboarding/Profile Setup: Users select their saving method (daily/weekly/monthly) and input income/spending to personalize their experience.

Goal Management: Create, edit, prioritize, and track multiple personal savings goals.

Visual Progress Pie Chart: See a beautiful, interactive pie chart at the top, visualizing completion rates for all goals.

Automated Savings Calculations: Savings advice and recommendations update dynamically based on user preferences and profile.

Reminders & Habit Builder: Get reminders and micro-saving encouragement to help stay on track.

Modern, Aesthetic Design: Clean, mobile-friendly, lavender-themed interface with animated progress and professional visuals.

Motivational & Educational Widgets:
Daily motivational tip from a public API
Live INR→USD exchange rate
Finance news headline or financial fact
unique_features: Goalie features smart onboarding with income/spending inputs to tailor savings plans. A dynamic pie chart shows all goals' progress visually. Automated savings recommendations adapt to each user's method. Users can prioritize multiple goals, get motivational tips, currency rates, and finance facts. No bank/UPI linking required—track any savings type. Profile settings are easily adjustable anytime.
third_party_integrations:
Here are all the current third-party (public API) integrations on Goalie app:

Daily Tip – Uses https://api.adviceslip.com/advice to display a motivational tip at the top of the app.

Currency Rate – Uses https://api.exchangerate.host/latest (INR→USD) to show the current exchange rate, with a static fallback.

Finance News – Uses https://finnhub.io/api/v1/news (demo endpoint) to show a finance headline, with a fallback motivational finance fact.
challenges_faced:
Challenges faced included building dynamic calculations that respond instantly to user profile changes, ensuring consistent updates across the app. Creating an interactive, brand-aligned pie chart for goal tracking required balancing aesthetics with responsiveness. Integrating APIs brought issues like outages, CORS errors, and inconsistent data—solved through fallbacks and user-friendly error messages.

Key learnings:
User experience is crucial—onboarding must be intuitive and meaningful for personalization. API integration requires resilient error handling due to unreliable external services. Finally, achieving a cohesive design across devices is difficult but essential; repeated UI refinements ensured a consistent, modern, lavender-themed experience.

feature_list: LiteraryChatBot lets users chat with iconic book characters like Sherlock Holmes or Dracula. It features a stylish chat interface, character-specific themes (e.g., dark mode for Dracula), and planned OpenAI integration for real-time, personality-driven replies. Users can also toggle between characters and customize themes. Optional features like text-to-speech will let characters speak aloud, enhancing the immersive literary experience.
unique_features: LiteraryChatBot stands out with AI roleplay as iconic literary figures like Holmes or Dracula, each replying in their distinct voice and style. Dynamic themes adapt to match the chosen character (e.g., dark mode for Dracula). It’s built for real-time responses via OpenAI and includes an optional text-to-speech feature to hear replies aloud. A clean, literary-themed interface with a sidebar for character selection completes the immersive reading-meets-chatting experience.
third_party_integrations: The LiteraryChatBot frontend uses React and ReactDOM for UI, with react-scripts (via Create React App) for builds. cross-env helps with environment setup. Webpack and Babel handle bundling and transpiling JS/JSX. ESLint ensures code quality, and @testing-library/jest-dom supports DOM testing. A local Babel plugin enables visual editing. Gemini 1.5 Flash API is integrated, likely for character simulation. Together, these tools support a responsive, extensible chat experience.
challenges_faced: Building LiteraryChatBot posed several challenges that offered valuable insights. First, crafting character-specific AI dialogue was difficult, requiring prompt engineering and modular structures for adding unique literary voices. Second, theme customization was complex; maintaining consistency while switching styles demanded a solid theme system using CSS variables or theme objects. Third, integrating third-party APIs (like OpenAI) involved handling auth, rate limits, and latency—solved with good abstraction and error handling. Fourth, designing an accessible, responsive UI was key; prioritizing semantic HTML, ARIA roles, and flexible layouts helped reach more users. Lastly, maintaining modular React architecture ensured scalability for future features like TTS or new characters. Together, these lessons shaped a flexible, immersive app.

feature_list: My app is a softcore aesthetic space that helps users express themselves emotionally through visuals, music, and writing. It includes a Home page that welcomes the user softly and introduces all the features. The Room tab lets users decorate their own dreamy space with items like beds, plushies, and sparkles. The Journal tab gives them soft daily prompts or space to write freely, unlocking decor and stars. The Music tab has a gentle quiz asking about moods and colors, and recommends Spotify songs based on the user’s vibe. The Shop allows users to buy cute room items and outfits using stars earned from journaling. The Profile page allows users to set up their name, pronouns, bio, picture, and avatar style. All these features work together to help users feel calm, seen, and cozy while creating a digital world that reflects their inner emotions.
unique_features: This app is unique because it combines emotional healing with creative decorating and aesthetic personalization. Instead of just writing or journaling, users get to build their own soft world where feelings become visual like placing a plushie after writing something deep. The room changes based on their progress, and each feature is linked to their mood. The music feature is not just playlists; it’s a quiz that understands their vibe and recommends matching tracks using the Spotify API.
third_party_integrations: The app uses Spotify’s API to fetch songs and playlists that match the user’s mood, based on answers from the music quiz. It also uses localStorage (or will use Firebase in future) to store user data such as profile info, journal entries, and room layout so that everything stays the same when the user returns.
challenges_faced: One of the biggest challenges was keeping the app simple while still making it magical and interactive. Designing a layout that uses full space and feels soft instead of boxed-in took time and multiple tries. Connecting emotions to visual rewards like decor made me think deeply about how users interact with feelings. Learning to use APIs like Spotify and localStorage helped me understand how data flows in an app. Writing soft prompts, comfort messages, and emotional feedback taught me how important UX tone is. I learned that users don’t just need features they need warmth, and building that into an app is a beautiful and rewarding challenge.

feature_list: The app is built on the concept of "What if?"—providing users with a safe, reflective space to explore alternative decisions they might have made in life. Whether it’s pursuing a different career, relocating, altering relationships, or adopting a new lifestyle, MirrorVerse allows users to interactively construct and experience those possibilities.
unique_features: MirrorVerse is an immersive, decision-based simulation web application designed to let users explore alternate versions of their lives through structured scenario-building and narrative pathways. Without relying on artificial intelligence, MirrorVerse leverages a modular, rule-based system to guide users through various life trajectories based on their choices and personality inputs.
